How we work

A 132-point AI SEO, AEO, GEO & AIO audit framework

Every engagement is measured against the same rigorous checklist — 132 parameters across 10 categories, spanning technical SEO, on-page optimization, E-E-A-T trust signals, answer engine structure, entity and knowledge-graph work, and AI discoverability.

Technical SEO HTTPS, sitemaps, indexability, Core Web Vitals infrastructure, llms.txt, AI crawler access 35 checks

On-Page SEO Titles, headings, keyword strategy, semantic entities, internal linking 35 checks

GEO — Generative Engine Optimization Entity graphs, SameAs, Wikidata, citation sources, knowledge panel readiness 35 checks

AEO — Answer Engine Optimization Direct answers, FAQPage, HowTo, featured snippets, voice search readiness 30 checks

E-E-A-T Author credentials, editorial policy, case studies, transparency signals 20 checks

AIO — AI Optimization Chunked sections, LLM-friendly formatting, retrieval blocks, AI-ready metadata 20 checks

UX & Accessibility WCAG, keyboard nav, contrast, sticky CTAs, accessible forms 20 checks

Performance Core Web Vitals, LCP, INP, CLS, caching, compression 20 checks

Analytics & Conversion GA4, GSC, heatmaps, funnels, call and form tracking, CRM integration 20 checks

AI Discoverability ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity & Copilot readiness, AI visibility score 20 checks

132 parameters, 10 categories — the same checklist applied to every client audit, from technical SEO through AI Discoverability.

Team expertise across SEO, AEO, GEO & AIO

Our team works across the full stack of modern search — from technical SEO foundations and on-page optimization, through E-E-A-T trust-building, to Answer Engine Optimization, Generative Engine Optimization, and Artificial Intelligence Optimization. That means structuring content for direct answers and featured snippets, building entity and knowledge-graph relationships for AI citation, implementing schema and structured data end-to-end, and validating AI discoverability across ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, and Copilot — all measured against the same 132-parameter checklist on every engagement, so nothing that affects visibility is left unchecked.

Frequently Asked Questions About Openink Hub

Is WhatsApp automation legal?

Yes. WhatsApp automation is legal when businesses follow WhatsApp Business Platform policies and obtain customer consent before sending promotional messages.

What is an AI chatbot?

An AI chatbot is a virtual assistant that uses artificial intelligence to understand customer questions and provide instant responses without human intervention.

Can AI chatbots replace human support?

AI chatbots handle common questions and repetitive tasks efficiently, while human agents remain essential for complex issues and personalized customer support.

What industries benefit from business automation?

Industries such as healthcare, education, real estate, retail, manufacturing, finance, hospitality, logistics, and professional services benefit significantly from automation.

What is Off-Page SEO and how does it improve website rankings?

SEO automation uses software and AI to simplify keyword research, technical audits, content optimization, reporting, and routine optimization tasks.

How does AI improve SEO?

AI analyzes search trends, identifies keyword opportunities, optimizes content structure, and helps create content that better matches user search intent.
